Fintegral is running vendor due diligence ahead of an analytics procurement (we've shortlisted Redwood). Our security team needs a copy of your SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent period, plus a short bridge letter if the report's audit window doesn't cover the current quarter.

Hi Taylor — thanks for the note and for considering Redwood.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we gate full SOC 2 Type II reports behind a mutual NDA.
- Our latest Type II covers the period 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31 (Type II report issued 2026-12-15).

Process we follow:
1) We exchange a countersigned mutual NDA (we can start from your template or provide ours).
2) Once the NDA is in place, our compliance team will provide a redacted PDF via a secure doc-share link.
3) If you need a bridge letter covering activity after 2026-12-31, we can produce a short attestation after legal review (usually 2–3 business days).

I attached our standard countersign copy of the NDA to streamline execution ("Redwood_NDA_Countersign.pdf"). Could you confirm whether you prefer to sign your template or accept ours? If you have a procurement PO number or a HubSpot deal ID, include it and we'll tag the request for priority.

I'll loop in Marissa (legal coordinator) and Karthik (account lead) to keep things moving.

Best,

Kimberly Park
